title: Recorded flood levels — historical references and September 26–27 episodes
unit: inches above SW grate (3.52 ft NAVD88)
scope: Nine entries from the prior all_anchors comparison, with corrected evidence labels, plus Sep13 round2 and three Sep26/27 floods. Not all27 registered episodes have comparable observed crest levels.
model_policy: Historical hindcasts retained as references; frozen models/goldens unchanged. Not as-issued forecasts or a common independent validation set. New coastal/second-round model comparisons pending.
